_comment: WP-24b first-run hints. On-screen text is English: the body font (Alegreya) has no Hangul glyphs. The triggers are battle_first (depth 1, room 0), reward_first and camp_first; a step's order here is the tutorial order.

steps.text: Move: 1 AP for up to 2 cells, and you can still use a skill after moving.
After a room: when a rune is offered, take one or skip the offer.
At camp, spend passive node points and fit or swap runes before you descend.
